name: Blake McCullough
strengths: McCullough gets the ball out fast on RPOs and screens — compact release, no hitch.
McCullough identifies pre-snap advantages and attacks numbers vs light boxes.
McCullough stands in and delivers knowing contact is coming — competitive toughness from the shotgun.
weaknesses: McCullough still needs cleaner intermediate ball placement — too many catch-radius throws into windows.
comparison: McCullough comps to Baker Mayfield — 6-1 competitive QB mold; throws with juice, creates when the pocket breaks, and plays with edge from the shotgun.
projection: McCullough projects as a develop-then-compete QB (scout Year 1, compete for the job Year 2–3). Ceiling: campus starter upside — never a rotational QB path; the Bishop Moore passer who can grow into a QB-room contender.
schemeFit: McCullough fits Faulkner shotgun / RPO spacing that rewards quick decisions and toughness in the pocket.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-08 from Hudl highlight reel. Comp size-matched to Baker Mayfield (6-1). QB path: develop → compete → starter upside.
insiderNotes: McCullough is a 6-1 competitive quarterback who gets the ball out on time, attacks pre-snap advantages, and does not flinch in the pocket. Intermediate placement and off-script creation are the next steps — the path is develop, then compete for the job, with starter upside.
recruitingStory: Blake McCullough is a 2028 Bishop Moore (FL) QB · listed 6-1 / 190 · in-state Florida target.
angle: Bishop Moore QB tape: quick release + pre-snap + toughness. Develop → compete → starter upside.
